description: Withdraw a question. Withdraw one open question you asked — it no longer needs an answer (you found it out yourself, or the item moved on). The question moves to `cancelled` and leaves the detail panel. Withdrawing the last open question of a run delivers nothing.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.
